sources.title: Microarray Analysis Identifies Changes in Inflammatory Gene Expression in Response to Amyloid-β Stimulation of Cultured Human Retinal Pigment Epithelial Cells
sources.source_location: Table 2, PSG8 / NM_182707; microarray and qRT-PCR methods
sources.finding: The PSG8-labelled probe has a reported 1.64-fold decrease after 24 hours of amyloid-β treatment (P=0.0123). This is an additional ocular RNA observation requiring assay-specific attribution.
sources.limitations: Probe specificity against other PSG genes has not been established in this review. PSG8 was not in the reported 17 upregulated genes selected for qRT-PCR validation.
